'''Special Edition Light Side Starter Deck''' is a 60-card [[Special Edition]] starter published by [[Decipher]] in November 1998. MSRP was $12.95. Each deck contains 22 starter-only cards (printed rarity '''F''', one of each title), plus 22 commons, 14 uncommons and 2 rares drawn at random from Special Edition. Those 38 random cards print '''C''', '''U''' or '''R''', the same rarities as Special Edition booster copies. The box also includes [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Rulebook 2.0]] and [[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Glossary 2.0]]. The Dark product is [[Special Edition Dark Side Starter Deck]]. A display box held 12 decks, 6 per side.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Card list ==
The Light Side Starter decks each contained 60 cards. 22 of these cards were fixed or identical across every Light Side Starter deck. The other 38 were random Special Edition commons, uncommons and rares.<ref name="encyc" />
